title: Fractal Core
description: Core library for my fractal bending mods.
body:
The core foundation for the Fractal Bending mod series. Provides the central ability registry, chi system, stat progression trees, player data storage, and command framework used by all elemental bending mods.

Features include:

Chi pool with regen, spending, and cost reduction mechanics
Elemental stat trees with skill point allocation (Chi and Damage categories per element)
Universal stat trees: Agility, Durability, and Stealth
Bending level progression via XP gained from ability usage
Elemental proximity buffs (water benders near water, fire benders near fire sources get bonus chi regen)
Player data persistence and sync between client/server
Commands for setting elements, viewing stats, and managing progression
This mod does nothing on its own — install at least one elemental bending mod alongside it.
